methodology: Reasoned estimates for scoped quality US agency work, triangulated from provider pricing, agency research and delivery effort. Not population averages, verified FM quotes or guaranteed savings.

rows.assumptions: 20 original concepts/captions and custom static branded graphics; modest channel set, scheduling and reporting; no original shoots.
rows.tooltip: Estimated $2,000/month for 20 custom branded posts, informed by Lotiva, The Hood Collective and scoped agency effort; actual quotes vary.

rows.assumptions: Small brand; inbound/outbound engagement and selected partner amplification; assumed 8–15 hours monthly with business-day coverage; no 24/7 moderation or paid influencer fees.
rows.tooltip: Estimated $1,500/month for active engagement and partner amplification, informed by Sprout Social’s historical agency survey, The Hood Collective and scoped effort.

rows.assumptions: Single business account; approximately $3,000–$15,000 monthly media spend; optimization, creative variants/tests, budget allocation and reporting; media and shoots extra.
rows.tooltip: Estimated $1,500/month for Meta optimization, creative testing and reporting, informed by GrossiWeb and Lotiva; advertising spend is separate.

rows.assumptions: Single business account; approximately $3,000–$15,000 monthly media spend; ad-copy tests, optimization, budget allocation and reporting; media and major production extra.
rows.tooltip: Estimated $1,500/month for Google Ads optimization, testing and reporting, informed by WebFX and Lotiva; advertising spend is separate.

rows.assumptions: One 1,000–1,500 word article with research, human writing/editing, metadata, internal links, basic image and CMS publishing. Monthly FM cadence is unconfirmed.
rows.tooltip: Estimated $600 per fully optimized, human-written article, informed by Express Writers and WebFX; monthly cost depends on the agreed article count.

rows.assumptions: Conditional scenario: four newsletters/campaigns monthly, copy/design/testing/reporting, opt-in forms/popups/lead-magnet optimization and simple automation. Software and acquisition media extra. FM cadence unconfirmed.
rows.tooltip: Estimated $2,500/month for four newsletters plus active list-growth work, informed by Lotiva’s scope and agency effort; software and acquisition ads are separate.

rows.assumptions: Conditional agency-support scenario: daily automated checks, patching, QA, tailored reporting and assumed 4–6 support/small-fix hours monthly. Does not imply daily human inspection. FM allowance unconfirmed.
rows.tooltip: Estimated $750/month for proactive agency care and a 4–6-hour support allowance, informed by BigScoots and Diggles Creative; lighter specialist care can cost less.

alternative_comparison_group.name: Productized specialist website care
alternative_comparison_group.note: Robust automated monitoring, updates and QA; different support/relationship model. Not a universal minimum.

rows.assumptions: One responsive conversion page with planning, copy, design/build, form/CTA/tracking and QA; limited revisions; no major custom integrations.
rows.tooltip: Estimated $3,000 for a complete custom landing page, informed by WebFX and Raised Media; copy, integrations and revision scope affect the quote.

rows.assumptions: One original responsive homepage with copy, design/build and QA in ordinary CMS, existing brand; no full multipage site. Uses one-page-site proxy.
rows.tooltip: Estimated $2,500 for a fully developed homepage, informed by Organiq Media’s one-page-site pricing and agency effort; this is a scoped estimate, not a homepage-only survey.

rows.assumptions: Ordinary About/Contact/information page reusing an existing design system; light copy, implementation and QA; no complex new template or custom logic.
rows.tooltip: Estimated $500 for an additional standard page, informed by Organiq Media and Web Design Miami Company; extensive copywriting or custom functionality increases scope.

rows.service: New GBP and website GA4 setup
rows.assumptions: One new eligible GBP: creation/verification assistance, optimization and supported account links; one standard site GA4 with ordinary events/conversions and QA; no disputes/ecommerce/multidomain complexity.
rows.tooltip: Estimated $1,500 for new GBP setup and optimization plus standard GA4 configuration, informed by GMB Gorilla and Eleventh Peak Digital; complex tracking costs more.
